subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after-compaction plugin hooks gain a core resetSession API, and if so, should OpenClaw support only resetSession(reason?) or also preserve the unshipped explicit-key form from the closed prior proposal?
rationale: This creates a public plugin capability that rotates persisted session state, while the compatibility overload derives from an unmerged proposal and repository policy requires explicit direction for new or parallel plugin contracts.

options.title: Approve one scoped signature
options.body: Expose resetSession(reason?) only on lifecycle-owned, resettable after-compaction contexts and remove the unshipped explicit-key overload.

options.title: Approve both signatures
options.body: Keep the explicit-key compatibility form, define its complete runtime semantics, and add focused contract and upgrade tests for every advertised call shape.

options.title: Do not add the hook API
options.body: Keep session reset behind existing gateway and command owners until a broader plugin lifecycle design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve one scoped signature
recommendation.body: Expose resetSession(reason?) only on lifecycle-owned, resettable after-compaction contexts and remove the unshipped explicit-key overload.
